summary: Verified A11Y tap-target improvements (iteration_13) on mobile 393x852 and 375x667. Hero dots and footer text links FAIL the >=40x40 requirement even after p-3/py-2 changes. Social icons (44x44) and mobile-menu-toggle rename pass. Zero regressions across /home, /quem-somos, /orcamento, /whatsapp.

ui_bugs.issue: Bounding box measured 34x34 for hero-dot-0..5 (p-3 = 12px padding + 10px dot = 34px). Requirement was >=40x40. Fix: use p-[15px] or p-4 (16px) to reach >=42px, or wrap inside a taller button with min-w/min-h-[40px].
Bounding box height = 36px for footer-eng-quem-somos, footer-duv-faq (py-2 = 8+8 + ~20px line height). Requirement was >=40. Fix: use py-3 (12px → 44px total) or add min-h-[40px] flex items-center.

action_items: Increase Home hero dot wrapper padding from p-3 to p-[15px] or p-4 so tap area >= 40x40 (currently 34x34).
Increase Footer text links vertical padding from py-2 to py-3 (or add min-h-[40px] flex items-center) so tap area >= 40 (currently 36px height).
critical_code_review_comments: p-3 (12px) + 10px dot yields 34px, which does not meet the >=40 A11Y touch target size. Consider p-[15px] to hit exactly 40, or p-4 for 42.
py-2 (8px) with ~20px text yields 36px height. py-3 gets 44px. Ensure line-height doesn't reduce actual box.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Positive checks passed: social icons 44x44, mobile-menu-toggle renamed on /whatsapp, hero dot onClick + aria-selected work, overflow-x=0 on all 4 routes @375 and @393, orc form submit → modal (close + whatsapp buttons) works, float-whatsapp target=_blank + wa.me href correct, header-logo + menu-quem-somos + menu-orçamento present. Only failures are numerical tap-area sizes (34 dots, 36 footer links).
